name: Herod
description: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament

points: “At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus”. This is Herod Antipas, a son of Herod the Great. A tetrarch is a governor over the land. His brother Archelaus was over a nation of people. After Herod the Great died the Romans would no longer give his sons the title of king; they had governorship over different parts of their father's kingdom. Even Herod the Great, called a king, was a vassal king: a king in name, answering to Rome.
Herod hears of him and says it is John, whom he beheaded, risen from the dead.

note.label: Mark 6: A Prophet Without Honour, the Death of John, and the Five Thousand

points: John had told Herod plainly, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife. Herod knew the law well enough to be accused by it, because those rulers were schooled in the customs of Israel.

note.label: Mark 6: A Prophet Without Honour, the Death of John, and the Five Thousand

points: Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod. They reason among themselves that it is because they have no bread.

note.label: Mark 8: The Four Thousand, the Confession of Peter, and the Cross

points: “Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea”. Before that, Herod's son Archelaus governed Judea, but only for about three years; he was a bad administrator for Rome, so Rome ruled him out of the way, made Judea a Roman province and put Pontius Pilate there, a Roman, not from Idumea.

“And Herod being tetrarch of Galilee”: that is the other son, Antipas. “And his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene”. The word tetrarch means governor: they were governors over these lands.
Herod, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which he had done, added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

note.label: Luke 3: The Preaching of John and the Generations Back to Adam

points: “And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” The steward in Herod's own house: people working for Herod were repenting. You think he didn't see that? Susanna was right there, and now she has a head cover and is not eating pork.

“And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward”: I wanted that because some of the women were married, and they continued and supported Christ. “And Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” That’s biblical, sisters, that is biblical; we’re not changing anything.
Herod is perplexed, hearing that John was risen from the dead, or that Elias had appeared, and says, John have I beheaded: but who is this?

note.label: Luke 9: The Twelve Sent, the Confession, and the Cost of Following

points: Herod was exceeding glad, hoping to have seen some miracle done by him, and questioned him in many words, but he answered him nothing.

note.label: Luke 23: The Trial, the Crucifixion, and the Burial

points: “And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.” What is the purpose of men of war? They beat him, and after they beat him they dressed him up and sent him back.

“And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.” They were not close, because Pilate had taken over Jerusalem after Herod's brother lost it. But against the Jews they became confederate, one people. So shall all nations become one people against us; they cannot afford us raising up.

For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together. So Herod, an Edomite, a white man that was set up by Rome to rule Jerusalem. And Pontius Pilate, another leader set up by Rome. With the Gentiles. And the people of Israel, the religious leaders. They were gathered together against Christ. Antichrist. Why? Because Herod understood, he killed thousands of black babies to prevent Christ from being born. That is antichrist. Because he knew that Christ was supposed to come, and Christ is the king, and he would not be ruling any more. The white man would not be ruling any more. So ever since Christ was born, the antichrist system was set up.
both Herod: Herod tried to kill him.

Being let go, they went to their own company and reported all, and they lifted up their voice to God with one accord: Lord, thou art God who made heaven and earth; why did the heathen rage and the people imagine vain things; the kings of the earth stood up and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Christ. Against the holy child Jesus, Herod, Pontius Pilate, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel were gathered together, and this same thing is going to happen all over again.

note.label: Acts 4: The Stone the Builders Rejected

points: The Divine Nine, the black sororities and fraternities that have always been a political force and took center stage in the 2024 election, are like groups in the Bible, such as the Herodians. The Herodians were a political group of Jews, black people, who supported the Herodian dynasty and sought to keep Herod’s rule in Judea under Roman authority. The Pharisees were religious and the Herodians were political, and though they were opposed to each other, the two joined together to destroy Christ. Christ warned of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod. The Herodians were compromisers who believed a client kingdom under the Herods was the best option, and they chose Herod over Christ.
“And Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.” Saul is the one who later became Paul. They went to the same schools of learning.

cases.charge: Taking his brother’s wife; beheading John for saying so
